gen.rule.station.platform_length.title: Platforma uzunligi
gen.rule.station.platform_length.desc: Platforma uzunligi: to'xtaydigan eng uzun poyezd plyus to'xtash zaxirasi; loyihaviy tanlov, uni operatorning poyezd uzunligi belgilaydi.
gen.rule.station.platform_width.title: Orol platformasi kengligi
gen.rule.station.platform_width.desc: Ikki cheti orasidagi orol platformasining kengligi; unda eskalator, zina va lift shaxtalari hamda har tomonda yurish yo'lagi joylashadi; loyihaviy tanlov.
gen.rule.station.edge_lane.title: Chekka yo'lak
gen.rule.station.edge_lane.desc: Shaxta va platforma cheti orasida hamda platforma bo'ylab shaxtalar orasida qoldiriladigan bo'sh yurish yo'lagi; loyihaviy tanlov.
gen.rule.station.trackway_width.title: Yo'l kengligi
gen.rule.station.trackway_width.desc: Platforma chetidan quti devorining ichki yuzasigacha: transport vositasi, uning gabarit zaxirasi va evakuatsiya yo'lagi; loyihaviy tanlov.
gen.rule.station.rail_depth.title: Rels chuqurligi
gen.rule.station.rail_depth.desc: Rels yuzasining yerdan pastdagi chuqurligi; liniya trassasi belgilaydi.
gen.rule.station.platform_height.title: Platforma balandligi
gen.rule.station.platform_height.desc: Platforma polining rels yuzasidan balandligi, poyezd poli bilan bir sathda; loyihaviy tanlov.
gen.rule.station.track_bed.title: Yo'l asosi
gen.rule.station.track_bed.desc: Rels yuzasidan asos plitasi yuzasigacha: relslar, shpallar va yo'l plitasi; loyihaviy tanlov.
gen.rule.station.cover.title: Grunt qatlami
gen.rule.station.cover.desc: Yopma plitasi ustidagi grunt: ko'cha kommunikatsiyalari, qoplama va ko'kalamzorlashtirish uchun joy; loyihaviy tanlov.
gen.rule.station.roof_slab.title: Yopma plitasi
gen.rule.station.roof_slab.desc: Grunt qatlami va ko'chani ko'taradigan yopma plitasi qalinligi; konstruktiv loyihadan oldingi loyihaviy tanlov.
gen.rule.station.base_slab.title: Asos plitasi
gen.rule.station.base_slab.desc: Yo'llar ostidagi, shuningdek qutini grunt suvlariga qarshi bosib turadigan asos plitasi qalinligi; loyihaviy tanlov.
gen.rule.station.floor_slab.title: Qavatlararo plita
gen.rule.station.floor_slab.desc: Vestibyul va platforma plitalarining qalinligi; loyihaviy tanlov.
gen.rule.station.concourse_height.title: Vestibyul balandligi
gen.rule.station.concourse_height.desc: Vestibyul polidan yopma plitasi ostki yuzasigacha: bosh ustidagi balandlik, belgilar va shift ustidagi muhandislik tarmoqlari; loyihaviy tanlov.
gen.rule.station.platform_clear.title: Platforma ustidagi bo'sh balandlik
gen.rule.station.platform_clear.desc: Platformadan vestibyul plitasining ostki yuzasigacha eng kam bo'sh balandlik; loyihaviy tanlov.
gen.rule.station.end_zone.title: Chekka zona
gen.rule.station.end_zone.desc: Quti har bir uchida platformadan tashqaridagi texnik zona uzunligi: ventilyatorlar, podstansiya, nasoslar; loyihaviy tanlov.
gen.rule.station.dwall_min.title: Eng yupqa diafragma devor
gen.rule.station.dwall_min.desc: Eng yupqa diafragma devor, eng kichik keng tarqalgan cho'mich kengligi; loyihaviy tanlov.
gen.rule.station.dwall_per_depth.title: Chuqurlikka devor
gen.rule.station.dwall_per_depth.desc: Qazish chuqurligining har bir metriga diafragma devor qalinligi; geotexnik loyihadan oldingi dastlabki o'lchamlash.
gen.rule.station.dwall_step.title: O'lcham qadami
gen.rule.station.dwall_step.desc: Devor qalinligi va shaxta o'lchamlari yuqoriga yaxlitlanadigan qadamlar; loyihaviy tanlov.
gen.rule.station.dwall_toe.title: Devor tovoni
gen.rule.station.dwall_toe.desc: Diafragma devorning asos sathidan pastga kirishi, qazish chuqurligi ulushida; geotexnik loyihadan oldingi dastlabki o'lchamlash.
gen.rule.station.peak_flow.title: Cho'qqi oqimi
gen.rule.station.peak_flow.desc: Cho'qqi vaqtida platformani tark etadigan soatiga odamlar soni; yo'lovchilar oqimi prognozi belgilaydi.
gen.rule.station.escalator_capacity.desc: Bitta eskalatorning amaliy o'tkazish qobiliyati; bir metrli pog'ona polosasi uchun loyihaviy tanlov.
gen.rule.station.escalator_banks.title: Eskalatorlar bloklari
gen.rule.station.escalator_banks.desc: Platforma va vestibyul orasidagi eskalatorlar bloklari, platforma bo'ylab joylashgan; loyihaviy tanlov.
gen.rule.station.escalator_standby.title: Zaxira eskalatorlar
gen.rule.station.escalator_standby.desc: Ta'mirlash uchun bittasini to'xtatish mumkin bo'lishi uchun har bir blokda cho'qqi oqimidan ortiq eskalatorlar; loyihaviy tanlov.
gen.rule.station.escalator_angle.title: Eskalator burchagi
gen.rule.station.escalator_angle.desc: Eskalatorlarning qiyaligi; loyihaviy tanlov, odatiy qiyalik.
gen.rule.station.escalator_width.title: Eskalator kengligi
gen.rule.station.escalator_width.desc: Eskalator shaxtasida balyustradalar bilan birga egallaydigan kenglik; loyihaviy tanlov.
gen.rule.station.escalator_landing.title: Eskalator maydonchasi
gen.rule.station.escalator_landing.desc: Eskalator shaxtasining har bir uchidagi tekis uzunlik: maydoncha va mexanizm chuqurligi; loyihaviy tanlov.
gen.rule.station.stair_width.title: Zina kengligi
gen.rule.station.stair_width.desc: Har bir eskalatorlar bloki yonidagi qo'zg'almas zina kengligi; loyihaviy tanlov, mamlakat to'plami talab qilgan chiqish kengligi uni almashtiradi.
gen.rule.station.stair_riser.title: Zina pog'onasi balandligi
gen.rule.station.stair_riser.desc: Bekat zinalarining eng baland pog'onasi; og'ir jamoat foydalanishi uchun loyihaviy tanlov.
gen.rule.station.stair_waist.title: Zina plitasi qalinligi
gen.rule.station.stair_waist.desc: Zina marshi plitasining qalinligi; loyihaviy tanlov.
gen.rule.station.stair_flow.title: Zina oqimi
gen.rule.station.stair_flow.desc: Evakuatsiyada zinaning bir metr kengligi daqiqasiga yuqoriga olib chiqadigan odamlar; loyihaviy tanlov.
gen.rule.station.train_load.title: Poyezd yuklamasi
gen.rule.station.train_load.desc: Bitta to'la poyezd platformaga olib keladigan odamlar; harakatlanuvchi tarkib belgilaydi.
gen.rule.station.evac_time.title: Evakuatsiya vaqti
gen.rule.station.evac_time.desc: Ikkita to'la poyezdni platformadan bo'shatishning eng uzun vaqti; loyihaviy tanlov, mamlakat to'plamining evakuatsiya vaqti uni almashtiradi.
gen.rule.station.psd.title: Platforma himoya eshiklari
gen.rule.station.psd.desc: 1 platformaning ikkala cheti bo'ylab himoya eshiklarini o'rnatadi.
gen.rule.station.psd_height.title: Himoya eshigi balandligi
gen.rule.station.psd_door_width.title: Himoya eshigi kengligi
gen.rule.station.train_door_pitch.title: Poyezd eshiklari qadami
gen.rule.station.train_door_pitch.desc: Poyezd eshiklari orasidagi masofa; platformaning har bir qadamiga bitta himoya eshigi.
gen.rule.station.lifts.title: Liftlar
gen.rule.station.lifts.desc: Platformadan ko'chagacha to'siqsiz kirish uchun liftlar; loyihaviy tanlov.
gen.rule.station.lift_shaft.title: Lift shaxtasi
gen.rule.station.lift_shaft.desc: Lift shaxtasi tomoni; zambil o'lchamli kabina uchun loyihaviy tanlov.
gen.rule.station.vent_flow.title: Shamollatish sarfi
gen.rule.station.vent_flow.desc: Tunnel shamollatishi bekatning har bir uchi orqali harakatlantiradigan havo; shamollatish tadqiqotidan oldingi loyihaviy tanlov.
gen.rule.station.vent_velocity.title: Shaxtadagi havo tezligi
gen.rule.station.vent_velocity.desc: Shamollatish shaxtasidagi havo tezligi; shovqin va bosim yo'qotishini past ushlab turuvchi loyihaviy tanlov.
gen.rule.station.column_spacing.title: Ustunlar oralig'i
gen.rule.station.column_spacing.desc: Platforma o'q chizig'idagi ustunlar orasidagi eng uzun masofa; loyihaviy tanlov.
gen.rule.station.column_size.title: Ustun o'lchami
gen.rule.station.column_size.desc: Kvadrat bekat ustunining tomoni; konstruktiv loyihadan oldingi loyihaviy tanlov.
gen.why.e.station_box: devorlar ichida {l} x {w} m quti: platforma {pl} m va {ez} m li ikkita chekka zona; platforma kengligi {pw} m, {tw} m li ikki yo'l orasida
gen.why.e.station_levels: rels yer ostida {rail} m: platforma sathi {pz} m, vestibyul {cz} m, asos plitasi yuzasi {bz} m
gen.why.e.station_clear: vestibyul plitasi ostida platformadan {h} m bo'sh balandlik, kamida {min} m
gen.why.e.station_dwall: qalinligi {t} m bo'lgan diafragma devorlar {bot} m gacha: qazish {exc} m va uning ostida {toe} m li tovon
gen.why.e.station_escalators: {banks} blokda {n} ta eskalator: cho'qqi {flow} kishi/soat, har bir eskalatorga {cap}, blokka {sb} ta zaxira
gen.why.e.station_well: eskalator shaxtasi {len} x {wid} m: {angle} gradusda {rise} m ko'tarilish va {land} m li maydonchalar
gen.why.e.station_stairs: eskalatorlar yonida kengligi {w} m bo'lgan {n} ta qo'zg'almas zina, har bir shaxta uzunligi {len} m
gen.why.e.station_lifts: platformadan ko'chagacha {s} x {s} m li {n} ta lift shaxtasi
gen.why.e.station_psd: har bir platforma chetida kengligi {w} m bo'lgan {n} ta himoya eshigi, har {pitch} m da, to'siq balandligi {h} m
gen.why.e.station_vent: {s} x {s} m li {n} ta shamollatish shaxtasi: har bir uchda {v} m/s tezlikda {flow} m3/s
gen.why.e.station_columns: o'q chizig'i bo'ylab {c} m li {n} ta ustun, bir-biridan ko'pi bilan {sp} m, birortasi ham shaxtada emas
gen.why.e.station_evac: platforma {t} daqiqada bo'shatildi: eskalator va zinalardan daqiqasiga {cap} dan {people} kishi, ko'pi bilan {lim} daqiqa
gen.rule.station.stair_gap.title: Zina marshlari oralig'i
gen.rule.station.stair_gap.desc: Maydonchada burilgan bekat zinasining ikki marshi orasidagi oraliq; loyihaviy tanlov.
gen.rule.station.lift_load.title: Lift yuk ko'tarish qobiliyati
gen.rule.station.lift_load.desc: Bekat liftining nominal yuklamasi; kabina shu yuklamaning kutubxona turi, 1000 kg dan boshlab zambil sig'adi.
gen.rule.station.vault_rise.title: Gumbaz ko'tarilishi
gen.rule.station.vault_rise.desc: Har bir tunnel silindrsimon gumbazining yopadigan oralig'iga nisbatan ko'tarilishi; loyihaviy tanlov, tepa vestibyul plitasi ostida qoladi.
gen.rule.station.vault_bay.title: Gumbaz segmenti uzunligi
gen.rule.station.vault_bay.desc: Yo'llar bo'ylab bitta gumbaz segmentining eng uzun uzunligi; loyihaviy tanlov, har bir konstruktiv oraliqqa bitta segment.
gen.rule.station.ground_margin.title: Yer tekisligi chekkasi
gen.rule.station.ground_margin.desc: Yer tekisligi quti devorlaridan tashqariga qanchalik cho'ziladi; loyihaviy tanlov.
gen.why.e.station_vaults: yo'llar va platforma ustida {bay} m li {n} ta silindrsimon gumbaz segmenti, ko'tarilishi oraliqning {k} qismi, tepasi vestibyul plitasi ostida
gen.why.e.station_ground: quti devorlari atrofida to'rt polosadan iborat yer tekisligi, ulardan {m} m narida; quti chuqur, ustida tuproq yo'q
gen.rule.station.vault_spring.title: Gumbaz tayanchi
gen.rule.station.vault_spring.desc: Tunnel gumbazining platformadan yuqorida eng past tayanchi; loyihaviy tanlov: odamning bo'sh balandligi va himoya eshiklari.
